subject: english
question: Select the sentence with no spelling errors.

options.text: There was acute disharmony in the room, where a little time before there had been at least an outward show of harmonie.
There was acute disharmony in the room, where a litle time before there had been at lest an outward show of harmony.
There was acute disarmony in the room, where a little time before there had been at least an outward show of harmony.
There was acute disharmony in the room, where a little time before there had been at least an outward show of harmony.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"disharmony"** means a lack of harmony or agreement. (असंगति)

 
 
• **Example: **The constant disharmony in the workplace led to a decline in productivity.
 
 
 
• **"Harmony" **refers to a state of agreement or concord. (सामंजस्य)
 
 
• **Example: **The choir sang in perfect harmony, creating a beautiful sound.
 
 
 
• Only in **option 4**, all the spellings in the sentence is correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1:** The word **"harmonie"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"harmony"**. (सामंजस्य)

 
 
• **Example: **The band played in perfect harmony, impressing the audience.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** The words **"litle"** and **"lest"** are incorrectly spelled. The correct spellings are **"little"** and **"least"**. (थोड़ा, सबसे कम)
 
 
• **Example: **She had the least amount of homework among her friends.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** The word **"disarmony"** is incorrectly spelled. The correct spelling is **"disharmony"**. (असंगति)
 
 
• **Example: **There was noticeable disharmony among the team members.
